Q1001.reason: A timely end-of-period notice was formally adequate, but serving it immediately after the tenant won a habitability defense is retaliatory eviction, which bars possession.

Q1008.reason: Outrageous conduct with knowledge that this bystander was present establishes recklessness toward him, and he may recover for the heart attack his known vulnerability made worse.

Q938.reason: Compressions work only if the patient lies level on a firm surface so each push goes straight down between sternum and spine without the body absorbing the force.
